work: Explicit technical verdict and coverage gate
behavior: Replace overall approval-by-slug with applicability and requirement results; unknown/unimplemented/open determination prevents complete compliance.
acceptance: A missing required rule or fact cannot yield all-code pass; violations remain visible alongside unknowns.
boundary: Partial checks cannot certify whole project.

behavior: Fix field aliases and strict type/enum/unit validation; unify file and conditional contracts; distinguish declared/extracted/verified facts.
acceptance: Existing adverse cases handled correctly; equivalent UI/API inputs produce identical results; invalid units/values fail validation.

behavior: Register adopted provisions, definitions, exceptions, interpretations and incorporated standards for every declared path; independently reconcile completeness.
acceptance: Every relevant provision accounted for; future code excluded before effective date; unavailable reference explicitly unsupported.
government_access_required: No government-system access; lawful source access required
boundary: This establishes the denominator; current all-code coverage is unknown.

behavior: Combine project scope, occupancy, code date, parcel geometry, overlays, plan districts and prior conditions; independent public-data/import adapters.
acceptance: No overlay outage means clear; wrong parcel and missing prior conditions block complete finding; validated applicability cases match experts.
boundary: Required facts unavailable from any source remain unresolved.

behavior: Securely parse documents; extract measurements/equipment/assemblies with page provenance; confirm uncertain facts and detect cross-sheet contradictions.
acceptance: Wrong parcel/units/revision, blank or misleading plan and contradictory dimensions detected or marked insufficient; metadata alone never proves design compliance.
boundary: Start with structured inputs and supported document formats; do not rely on unverified AI judgment.

behavior: Build reviewed answer-key cases, boundaries/exceptions/missing-data tests, cross-rule tests, valid metamorphic properties and mutation testing.
acceptance: Zero known unsupported passes; separately report false violations, abstention and resolved coverage; expected outcomes independently justified.
boundary: Runs alongside every rule pack, not after feature expansion.

behavior: Bind results to evidence/project/rule versions; invalidate changed facts and rerun affected checks; produce reproducible report.
acceptance: Changed dimensions/material/occupancy/plan cannot retain stale pass; frozen evidence reproduces original result without live services.
boundary: Technical validity, independent of official approval records.

behavior: Implement and validate all inventoried requirements for an explicit supported site/project class; separate exemption determination and design compliance.
acceptance: Material/height/location/vision/pool/overlay cases and exclusions reconciled; every case includes requirement/evidence coverage report.
boundary: Foundation demonstration; not comprehensive support for every fence/site.

behavior: Apply the ledger and engine to zoning geometry and a defined prescriptive residential/ADU path across all triggered code families.
acceptance: Independent full-plan cases; no all-code pass while building/energy/fire/trade requirements remain unsupported; corrections update every affected result.
boundary: Tests whether architecture covers an actual substantive plan review.

work: Technical trade and solar rule packs
behavior: Implement design/equipment/load/installation rule checks with source-specific applicability; do not treat no-plan-review eligibility as code compliance.
acceptance: Underlying technical requirements evaluated for declared supported scopes; engineered/unknown/unsupported alternatives visibly handled.
boundary: Expand by validated rule reuse and project demand.

behavior: Incrementally cover assemblies, occupancy/egress/accessibility, structural/energy, trees/site and referenced-standard dependencies.
acceptance: Every new scope has independent provision inventory and representative answer-key validation before complete-compliance claims.
government_access_required: No; some facts/interpretations require external evidence
boundary: Discretionary and hidden physical facts remain explicitly identified.
